# SageStone

> SageStone connects U.S. businesses with dedicated virtual assistants, customer support, executive assistance, back-office and remote operations talent based in the Philippines. Engagements begin onboarding within 24–72 hours of a discovery call, and SageStone stays involved with ongoing oversight.

## Services
- [Virtual Assistant Services](https://www.sagestoneinc.com/services/virtual-assistant-services): inbox, calendar, research and admin support
- [Customer Support Outsourcing](https://www.sagestoneinc.com/services/customer-support-outsourcing): email, chat and help-desk support
- [Workflow Support](https://www.sagestoneinc.com/services/workflow-support): process mapping and coordination
- [Back Office Support](https://www.sagestoneinc.com/services/back-office-support): data, documentation and administrative work
- [Executive Assistant Services](https://www.sagestoneinc.com/services/executive-assistant-services): senior, discreet support for leaders
- [Remote Operations Support](https://www.sagestoneinc.com/services/remote-operations-support): embedded operators for scaling teams
